interpretive.rule: Strict compliance; automatic forfeiture upon proof of violation
Yo-yo financing is a multi-document violation; FTC Holder Rule makes assignees liable
E-signature transactions still subject to single-document rule

operational_notes_for_steward_cases.first_analysis_step: For each of the four auto fraud cases, inventory every signed document in the sale file. If more than one signed document covers a single transaction, §2981.9 single-document rule is violated; forfeiture under §2983 attaches automatically.
operational_notes_for_steward_cases.damages_model: Forfeiture of finance charge (§2983) + CLRA damages (§1780) + UCL restitution (§17203) + §2983.4 attorney fees + common-law punitive damages (§3294) if fraud proven.
operational_notes_for_steward_cases.assignee_liability: If the dealer assigned the installment contract to a finance company, the finance company is also liable under the FTC Holder Rule per Nelson.
